Definition: from G1861; a self-committal (by assurance of conferring some good):--promise.
BiblicalUsage: Peter calls them exceeding great and precious promises in 2 Peter 1:4 — promises by which we become partakers of the divine nature — and says we look for new heavens and a new earth according to His promise in 2 Peter 3:13.
TheologicalSignificance: The promises are the means by which He makes me a partaker of His nature, I believe, and the new heavens are not a dream but a promise I can look for.
